search_text: published ZDI-26-385 ZDI-CAN-30116 Unraid Web Server FileUpload Command Injection Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2026-06-24 CVE-2026-9772 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-9772 8.8 AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H ['Unraid'] ['Unraid'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Unraid. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within FileUpload.php. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied string before using it to execute a system call. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the www-data user. Fixed in version 7.3.0 stable ( https://docs.unraid.net/unraid-os/release-notes/7.3.0/ ) ['2026-04-22 - Vulnerability reported to vendor', '2026-06-24 - Coordinated public release of advisory', '2026-06-24 - Advisory Updated'] Swagat Kumar Mishra(https://www.linkedin.com/in/swagatkumar/) https://www.zerodayinitiative.com/advisories/ZDI-26-385/
title: Unraid Web Server FileUpload Command Injection Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Unraid. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within FileUpload.php. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied string before using it to execute a system call. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the www-data user.
